items.title: Oil Falls on Fresh Iran War Diplomacy, Talks on Hormuz
items.summary: Oil extended declines as fresh diplomatic efforts helped renew optimism the Iran war would not escalate, while a US plan to ramp up economic pressure on Tehran spared the country’s trading partners from harsher measures for now.

items.title: US stocks today: US stocks close higher on tech rebound as Nvidia earnings gain focus
items.summary: US stocks closed higher as technology and semiconductor shares recovered ahead of Nvidia's earnings. Lower oil prices and Treasury yields offered relief, while investors assessed AI spending and stretched valuations. Weak consumer confidence added to economic concerns, with upcoming PCE inflation data and Fed commentary keeping rate expectations in focus.

items.title: Japanese financial institutions flag currency fluctuations
items.summary: Japanese financial institutions noted currency fluctuations and policy issues affecting investment decisions. They expressed confidence in India's long-term growth prospects and discussed boosting capital flow. Firms stressed simplifying profit repatriation and improving market access for investors. Greater regulatory predictability was also highlighted as important for long-term commitment. Discussions occurred during Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal's visit.

items.title: Taking Stock: Window to process and sell imported sugar extended
items.summary: The government has extended the deadline for selling imported sugar domestically. Importers now have two months to sell processed sugar after filing bills. This change comes as domestic sugar prices reached record highs recently. Sugar millers had requested more time due to import processing delays. India's closing sugar stock is projected to be lower than targeted.

items.title: Widening trade gap with Japan a concern, Ficci flags
items.summary: India's trade deficit with Japan is a growing concern for local exporters.  Indian companies face hurdles accessing the Japanese market due to strict regulations.  Ficci president Anant Goenka highlighted these challenges during a Japan visit.  Joint investments in Africa are being explored to secure supplies and expand mining.  Opportunities exist for deeper cooperation in data centres and semiconductor sectors.

items.title: Goyal signals BIS certification exemption for high-tech companies, including those from Japan
items.summary: India is developing a framework to exempt high-tech companies from BIS certification. This aims to facilitate the setup of manufacturing facilities for advanced industries. Japanese firms had raised concerns regarding complex certification rules for imported equipment. The government seeks to boost the 'Make in India' initiative and attract investments. India's semiconductor demand is projected to reach $150 billion by 2032.

items.title: SC refuses to reopen Class 12 CBSE revaluation portal
items.summary: The Supreme Court declined to reopen the CBSE Class XII exam verification portal.  The court noted the portal was already open for all students.  Reopening the portal could lead to numerous fresh claims from students.  A plea challenged the On-Screen Marking system's implementation without teacher training.  The plea alleged scanning irregularities and evaluation errors in answer sheets.

items.title: L&T wins ₹5,000-10,000 cr 'major' order to build 3 battery storage projects in Middle East
items.summary: Larsen & Toubro said its renewables business has won a major order in the Middle East to develop three battery energy storage system projects with a combined capacity of 6 GWh.

items.title: Short Squeeze in US Swaps, Options Shows ‘Bessent Put’ at Work
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent’s surprise plan to tamp down US borrowing costs by expanding bond buybacks may have sparked fierce debate about its ultimate effectiveness, but key market metrics and positioning show that it’s having an impact.

items.title: ONGC to revive Venezuela oilfield
items.summary: ONGC Videsh will invest $200 million to revive Venezuela's San Cristobal oilfield.  The company secured a US license for continued operations and investments.  This investment aims to significantly increase current production levels.  The ultimate goal is to restore output to its previous peak.  ONGC will fund PDVSA's share and recover costs from future production.

items.title: Court stops FSSAI from cancelling ITC's licence over its '100%' claims
items.summary: The Delhi High Court has restrained FSSAI from cancelling ITC's licence. This action follows a dispute over the "100%" claim on Aashirvaad Chakki Atta. The court sought a response from the health ministry regarding the advisory. ITC challenged the FSSAI advisory as arbitrary and beyond its powers. The next hearing is scheduled for September 9.

items.title: Tribunal deletes Reliance Jio Infocomm's Rs 11,000 cr tax disallowance
items.summary: The income tax appellate tribunal deleted a large tax disallowance for Reliance Jio Infocomm.  It ruled that accounting treatment does not solely determine tax treatment of expenditure.  The tribunal dismissed tax appeals concerning operational costs capitalized by the company.  It found no new enduring asset was created by the disputed expenses.  This decision upheld the deletion of the entire ₹11,003 crore disallowance.

items.title: Hyderabad Airport to slash user fees from Sept 1
items.summary: Hyderabad airport passenger fees will decrease starting September 1, 2026.  The aviation regulator has slashed airport development charges for millions of travelers.  Domestic departure fees will drop to ₹515 from the current ₹750.  International departure fees will also fall from ₹1,500 to ₹1,030.  Arriving passengers will pay reduced fees for both domestic and international travel.

items.title: Indians part with old jewellery to cash in on soaring gold prices
items.summary: Household gold sales are surging as prices reach record highs this month. Consumers are liquidating gold to meet rising living costs and secure gains. Major jewelers like Kalyan Jewellers and Tanishq now offer expanded cash-for-gold services. This trend brings a traditional service into the organized retail sector for sourcing recycled gold. Consumers are increasingly using household gold for other purchases due to inflation.

items.title: Varun Beverages to foray into alcohol biz, set up subsidiary
items.summary: Varun Beverages is entering the alcohol business by incorporating a new subsidiary.  The company has appointed Prathmesh Mishra as the chief executive officer.  This new entity will focus on ready-to-drink alcoholic beverages and allied products.  Varun Beverages will also establish a joint venture company in Tunisia.  This diversification follows recent agreements allowing expansion into other drink businesses.

items.title: Broad-base rise in food prices despite monsoon recovery, RBI's state of economy report shows
items.summary: India's economy shows resilience with improved domestic demand and strong activity. Food prices have seen a broad-based increase, impacting inflation targets. Global economic outlook faces challenges from West Asia conflicts and US tariffs. India's financial markets record high credit growth and comfortable liquidity. The country's macroeconomic fundamentals provide a cushion against global risks.

items.title: Sunny side down? Egg prices rise on ethanol push
items.summary: Rising diversion of maize to ethanol production has significantly increased poultry feed costs, leading to a 35-40% surge in egg prices over the past year. Maize prices have nearly doubled in three years, impacting the poultry industry which relies on it for 65-70% of its production costs. Experts anticipate further price increases as winter demand rises and maize diversion for ethanol is projected to grow.

items.title: Varun Beverages to foray into alcoholic beverages, board clears KIVA Spirits unit
items.summary: KIVA Spirits will be incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary of Varun Beverages in India. Its mandate will include the manufacture, marketing, sale and distribution of RTD alcoholic drinks and related products, subject to required statutory and regulatory clearances.

items.title: Grip strength, gait may soon measure biological lifespan, says Dr Prateek Sharma
items.summary: Genes influence lifespan, but lifestyle and environment are crucial for longevity.  Biological age will soon be measured by new indicators beyond chronological age.  Healthy life expectancy boosts India's economy significantly, benefiting all stakeholders.  The focus is shifting from lifespan to healthspan, adding energy and reducing disease.  Evidence-based nutrition science is vital, dispelling myths about magic diets.

items.title: Franklin’s Araghi Says Nvidia Holders Want Map, Not Just a Beat
items.summary: Franklin Templeton’s Sara Araghi said Nvidia Corp. needs to go beyond a headline earnings beat and provide investors with concrete detail on how it plans to deploy capital and sustain its spending plans.

items.title: British Virgin Islands seeks dedicated India investment corridor
items.summary: The British Virgin Islands (BVI) is seeking to deepen its role in India’s cross-border investment ecosystem by proposing a dedicated BVI-India investment corridor as Indian companies expand overseas and global investors seek access to India.

items.title: Carlisle Investors to approach PMO over alleged HDFC Bank mis-selling
items.summary: Investors are planning to write to the Prime Minister's Office this week.  They allege mis-selling and substantial losses from a Carlisle product.  The group also intends to approach the Reserve Bank of India.  They are exploring legal action against HDFC Bank for alleged client-suitability lapses.

items.title: Russia-Ukraine war likely to raise import price of sunflower oil, yellow peas
items.summary: The escalation of the Russia-Ukraine war could raise India’s import costs for sunflower oil and yellow peas, as attacks and shipping disruptions in the Black Sea have sharply reduced exports from the region.

items.title: New mines law seeks to bring tax uniformity
items.summary: A new Mines and Minerals Act, 2026, aims to standardize mining taxation across India.  This legislation seeks to bring uniformity and predictability to financial viability for mining activities.  It addresses pending retrospective levies, providing greater certainty and confidence to the industry.  The move follows a Supreme Court verdict allowing states to levy additional taxes.

items.title: Rekha Gupta-led Delhi govt takes big action to tackle elevated onion and sugar prices
items.summary: CM Rekha Gupta's administration is preparing to procure onions from food cooperative National Agricultural Cooperative Marketing Federation of India (NAFED) and make them available at lower prices, if required, while tracking retail sugar prices closely. The government has warned of stringent action against hoarders and black-marketers.

items.title: Regional rural banks told to speed up tech adoption
items.summary: Regional rural banks are urged to accelerate modern technology adoption and digital services.  Their net profit reached an all-time high of ₹10,176 crore in FY26.  Sponsor banks must handhold RRBs in strengthening their IT infrastructure.  The total business of all 28 RRBs has now crossed ₹13.5 lakh crore.

items.title: Crude oil prices slide 4% as markets look past Iran sanctions
items.summary: Oil prices dropped significantly as traders viewed new US sanctions on Iran less severely.  Brent crude and West Texas Intermediate both reached their lowest levels since mid-August.  The sanctions announcement was less aggressive than anticipated by many market participants.  However, Iran has vowed retaliation, and shipping risks remain a concern for traders.  Supply disruptions in Russia and Kazakhstan also occurred, but focus remains on Iran.

items.title: EAC moots consolidation to create a few large banks
items.summary: India needs to consolidate banks into a few large entities. This consolidation aims to meet rising credit needs for Viksit Bharat by 2047. Banks will increasingly focus on data-driven customer experiences and AI automation. The banking sector has seen significant positive changes since 2014. Future agendas include mobilizing stable deposits and deepening productive lending.

items.title: Uttarakhand government approves 25-year power procurement from Adani Power
items.summary: The Uttarakhand Cabinet approved a 25-year power purchase agreement with Adani Power for 1,320 MW of coal-based electricity at ₹5.746 per unit. The power will come from a plant being set up in Chhattisgarh and is expected to be supplied to the state from FY30.

By mapping out all work AI models could automate, Anthropic aims to justify its massive infrastructure spending, support its projected $200 billion 2028 revenue target, and validate its upcoming stock listing.

items.summary: Private credit investments in India's food and beverage sector surged twelvefold in early 2026. This sector's share of total deal value rose to twelve percent, becoming the third largest. Large transactions supported this momentum, indicating growing capital demand for expansion. Private credit investors are increasingly exploring consumer-led sectors for new opportunities.

Combining TV and digital advertising significantly boosts brand penetration for most studied products.  A balanced media mix across both channels proves more effective than a skewed approach.  Personal care brands achieve higher penetration with less frequent ad exposure.  Non-skippable YouTube ads also outperform bumper ads for brand penetration.
